observations: A cream-colored hair dryer with a transparent plastic hood is shown in three photos.
The unit is mounted on a black stand with a base and a handle, suggesting it is a salon or spa-style hair dryer.
The hood has a black trim and a small black knob or switch on the front.
The unit is placed next to a black salon chair with a mannequin head on it.
The background shows a window with metal bars, a curtain, and some wooden poles or sticks leaning against the wall.
The photos are dated 2026/10/10, but the watermark 'Debbie's collections' suggests they are from a personal or resale listing, not a professional salon.
No power cord is visible in any photo, and no control panel or buttons are clearly shown.

claims.evidence: The unit appears used, but there is no visible damage or wear to confirm 'fairly used'. The photos do not show the interior, motor, or control panel, which are critical for assessing condition.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The hair dryer may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the control panel, power cord, and motor, showing no fraying, burns, or broken parts.

risks.risk: The unit may have been used in a salon or for commercial purposes, leading to wear or residue.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior of the hood and the base, showing cleanliness and no signs of heavy use or residue.

risks.risk: The power cord may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full length of the power cord and its condition.

proof_requests: Close-up of the control panel and power cord.
Photo of the interior of the hood and base.
Photo showing the full length of the power cord.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
